items.title: ENERGY STAR Transitioning From EPA to DOE
items.summary: Primary oversight of the ENERGY STAR program is moving from the EPA to the DOE; downlight and ceiling fan certification programs remain active, which may affect efficiency labeling and specification criteria.

items.title: Product Monday: Korrus Ecosense Circadian Lighting Line
items.summary: Korrus launched an integrated Ecosense circadian lighting line spanning multiple fixture types, aiming to provide full-space tunable, biologically-informed lighting rather than isolated bulbs or single fixtures.

items.title: DALI Alliance announces DALI 27 Inaugural Global Summit + Expo
items.summary: The DALI Alliance will hold its first Global Summit and Expo, DALI 27, in February 2027 in Utrecht, gathering lighting and smart-building stakeholders to advance digital lighting control standards.

items.title: Product Monday: Venetian Blinds Upcycled Into Luminaires
items.summary: A designer repurposed reclaimed aluminium venetian blind slats, components normally used for daylight control, into a modular luminaire family that directs and diffuses artificial light, demonstrating a circular-economy approach to fixture manufacturing.
